name: Alice
source:
Initial Class: Fighter

[url=/c57596]Jack's[/url] childhood friend who was kidnapped by the Marchen and thrown into the Jail together with Jack when they were younger. Ever since then, they have been kept alive there as inmates. Though calculative and serious most of the time, Alice lets her emotions free when she talks to or talks about Jack.

After getting rescued by [url=/c57583]Akazukin[/url], she finds out that she is one of the Chishiki Girls, meaning that she reacts uniquely to the Marchens's blood and is able to fight against them.
